summary: The agent successfully completed a SOC alert queue planning task involving Excel data processing with pandas. Key learning: modern Debian/Ubuntu systems block direct pip installs due to PEP 668 externally-managed-environment protection. The agent correctly used --break-system-packages after encountering the error, but this pattern of trial-and-error package installation is brittle and wastes tokens. This skill captures the reusable pattern for Excel data processing in constrained Python environments, including the package installation workaround, pandas/openpyxl usage patterns, and validation steps.
